briefs.heading: Where should the reports API keep its cache?
briefs.recommend: the hit rate is still a guess, and the in-process cache needs no new service
options: each server keeps its own copy, so there is nothing new to run
each server warms up alone, so a restart sends a burst of reads to the database
all servers read one copy, so the hit rate is higher
one more service to run, and every read crosses the network

checked.text: `reports.log` shows 120 requests per second at the busy hour
